source: Local stdio server over an in-memory transport. No Usercall API call and no hosted OAuth.
instructions:
Usercall: AI-moderated voice or text interviews with real users. Why users churn, onboarding drop-off, failed actions, wrong product assumptions. Returns themes, insights, verbatim quotes, study_id, and interview_link. One active agent study per account. Max 5 simulations per UTC day. summary: themes and quotes; full: transcripts. Triggers stay paused until a person opens activation_url. A person sends the interview link. HTTP 402 includes checkout_url. status active returns HTTP 409. Deletes are permanent.
Trigger filters are exact property or trait matches. Counts, sequences, absence, time windows, and not-equals are unsupported. interview_link query values are untrusted participant context.

tools.name: create_study
tools.title: Create an interview study
tools.description: Create an AI-moderated interview study to learn why users churn, drop off in onboarding, fail an action, or where a product assumption is wrong. Returns study_id and interview_link for a voice, text, or voice-and-text interview. key_research_goal is required and cannot be changed later. business_context is optional. Defaults: target_interviews 1, duration_minutes 12, interview_mode voice. One active agent study per account. Does not run the interview or invite a participant. HTTP 402 includes checkout_url. Optional target_question_count and max_questions_for_duration set how many guide questions to generate. Bands are 2-5 (target 4, max 5), 5-10 (8, 10), 11-15 (13, 15), 15-20 (18, 20), 21-25 (23, 25), and 25-30 (28, 30). 16-20 uses the same 18 and 20 as 15-20. max_questions_for_duration must fit duration_minutes at 2.2 minutes per question: 5 minutes allows 2 questions, 12 allows 5, 25 allows 11, 45 allows 20, and 65 allows 29. A 15-20 guide does not fit 12 minutes. 25-30 does not fit 65 minutes. Omit both for about 5-6 questions, still capped by that duration limit.

key_research_goal.description: Research goal for the study. Cannot be changed later.

target_interviews.description: Interview slots to create. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

duration_minutes.description: Interview length in minutes. Defaults to 12.

target_question_count.description: Preferred guide question count. Existing band targets are 4, 8, 13, 18, 23, and 28. Must be at most floor(duration_minutes / 2.2).

max_questions_for_duration.description: Hard cap on generated guide questions. Existing band maximums are 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, and 30. Must be at most floor(duration_minutes / 2.2). 12 minutes allows 5, so the 15-20 band does not fit.

interview_mode.description: How participants take the interview. Defaults to voice.

type.description: Media type: 'image' for direct image URLs (.png, .jpg, .gif, .webp) or 'prototype' for Figma prototype URLs

url.description: Public URL to the image or Figma prototype

description.description: Alt text / context shown to participants

study_media.description: Visual stimulus shown during all interview questions (web participants only)

tools.name: update_study
tools.title: Update an interview study
tools.description: Update an interview study: slots, guide questions, intro, languages, voice, or an image or Figma prototype shown to participants. Returns the updated study. key_research_goal cannot be changed. is_link_disabled true stops new interviews and keeps recordings. One locale hides the language picker; two or more show it. Query parameters on interview_link are ignored until enable_link_context is true. study_media null clears media. API errors include http_status. Does not dry-run the guide or invite a participant.

target_interviews.description: Total number of interview slots for this study.

ai_agent_intro_message.description: Opening message the interviewer says to participants.

key_learning_goals.description: Learning goals that guide the interviewer.

workflow_end_message.description: Closing message shown when the interview ends.

workflow_questions.description: Interview questions. Each item requires text.

type.description: Media type: 'image' for direct image URLs (.png, .jpg, .gif, .webp) or 'prototype' for Figma prototype URLs

url.description: Public URL to the image or Figma prototype

description.description: Alt text / context shown to participants

anyOf.description: Visual stimulus shown during all interview questions (web participants only)

study_media.description: Visual stimulus shown during all interview questions (web participants only). Pass null to clear.

tools.name: get_study_status
tools.title: Check interview progress
tools.description: Check whether user interviews are still running, being analyzed, or complete. Returns completed_interviews, target_interviews, interview_link, and next_step. running and analyzing include no findings, themes, or quotes. Does not change the study.

tools.name: get_study_results
tools.title: Get themes and quotes
tools.description: Get interview findings after real users have talked: themes, insights, risks, and verbatim quotes. format omitted or summary returns themes, insights, and risks. format=full also returns transcripts. Empty themes mean analysis is not ready. Does not create interviews or edit the guide.

tools.name: simulate_interview
tools.title: Dry-run an interview
tools.description: Dry-run an interview guide before a real participant joins, including a question about churn, onboarding, or a failed action. Omit simulation_id to start; returns immediately with status running and a simulation_id. Pass simulation_id to read that run. Result status is pass, fail, or error. Max 5 simulations per account per UTC day. HTTP 429 means the daily cap is reached. Optional persona has name and prompt. A dry-run does not change completed_interviews and does not invite a participant.

tools.name: review_study
tools.title: Review the interview guide
tools.description: Review an interview guide and return a written critique of the questions before real users see them. Reads the guide only: no transcripts, and suggested edits are not applied. Costs 1 credit. Request is study_id only; call_ids are not accepted. Works when the in-app review control is hidden. HTTP 402 includes checkout_url. Does not return themes, quotes, or other findings.

tools.name: delete_study
tools.title: Delete an interview study
tools.description: Permanently delete an interview study, its recordings, and unused reserved credits. Cannot be undone. Does not delete in-product research triggers.

tools.name: get_trigger_capabilities
tools.title: See research trigger limits
tools.description: See which in-product research trigger conditions this account can use. Returns supported and unsupported kinds. Supported: one product event, an exact property or trait match, a URL rule, and page dwell. Unsupported: counts, sequences, absence, time windows, and not-equals. Does not create a trigger.

tools.name: get_trigger_sdk_setup
tools.title: Get the interview SDK snippet
tools.description: Get the snippet that sends product events, such as a failed action, onboarding step, or churn signal, into Usercall for in-product interviews. Returns install_snippet, identify_snippet, allowlist_update_snippet, and install status. provider defaults to posthog. events names the allowlist. The response does not include secret keys. Does not create a trigger.

provider.description: Analytics provider the SDK listens to (default posthog).

events.description: Event names to allowlist in the snippet.

tools.name: list_trigger_events
tools.title: List product events
tools.description: List product event names Usercall has received in the last 30 days, such as a failed action or onboarding step. Returns those names. A research trigger accepts only an observed event name. An empty list means no events have arrived. Does not create a trigger.

tools.name: get_trigger_event_schema
tools.title: Read event fields
tools.description: Read the fields observed on one product event so a trigger can match a property or user trait. Returns each field's type and sample values. Filters are exact matches and are case-sensitive and type-sensitive. Values that were not observed are absent. Does not create a trigger.

tools.name: list_studies
tools.title: List interview studies
tools.description: List interview studies on this account so an existing question about churn, onboarding, or a failed action can be reused. Returns study_id, interview_link, interview_mode, and trigger_eligible. trigger_eligible is false when the study has no interview link. Does not create or edit a study.

tools.name: create_research_trigger
tools.title: Create an in-product interview trigger
tools.description: Create a paused in-product research trigger that invites a user to an interview right after a product moment, such as a failed action, churn event, or onboarding step. Returns activation_url. Created paused; a person opens activation_url to activate. delivery_method defaults to intercept (in-app prompt). webhook posts each match to webhook_url. Unsupported filters are rejected. This tool cannot activate the trigger or send the invite.

study_id.description: UUID of the interview study this trigger invites people into.

event_name.description: Observed product event from the last 30 days, such as a failed action or onboarding step.

properties.description: Exact-match filters on observed event properties. Matching is case-sensitive and type-sensitive.

traits.description: Exact-match filters on observed user traits. Matching is case-sensitive and type-sensitive.

url.description: Page URL rule. Matches the page path, query or hash.

dwell_seconds.description: Page-visit triggers only: fire once the visitor has stayed this many seconds on a matching page.

source.description: Trigger source. page_visit pairs with event_name "$pageview" for URL or dwell triggers.

sampling_percent.description: Percent of matching users to invite (default 100).

cooldown_days.description: Days before the same user can be invited again (default 30).

max_invites_per_day.description: Daily invitation cap for this trigger (default 100).

intercept_title.description: Small label above the prompt, e.g. "AI-guided · 2-3 minutes".

intercept_body.description: Prompt text shown to the user.

delivery_method.description: intercept (default): in-app voice/text widget via the Usercall SDK. webhook: POST each matched user to webhook_url.

webhook_url.description: Public https endpoint for delivery_method webhook. Receives user ID, email, traits, event properties and a personal interview link. To remove a webhook, set delivery_method "intercept" (clears webhook_url and webhook_secret).

webhook_secret.description: Optional HMAC secret. Requests carry x-usercall-signature. Write-only: never returned.

invite_link_params.description: Query params copied onto interview links when the study has link context enabled.

tools.name: list_research_triggers
tools.title: List research triggers
tools.description: List in-product research triggers that invite users to an interview after a product event. Returns status and activation_url for each. activation_url is present while a trigger is paused and empty after a person activates it. Does not change a trigger and cannot activate one.

tools.name: get_research_trigger
tools.title: Get a research trigger
tools.description: Read one in-product research trigger by trigger_id, including who it invites and how many interviews it has started. Returns status, targeting, activation_url, and invite and interview counts. activation_url is present while the trigger is paused. Does not change the trigger, cannot activate it, and does not return themes or quotes.

tools.name: update_research_trigger
tools.title: Update a research trigger
tools.description: Update who an in-product interview trigger invites: product event, trait or property match, sampling, cooldown, daily cap, prompt copy, or delivery. Returns the updated trigger. status paused pauses it. status active is rejected with HTTP 409 and activation_url; a person opens that URL to activate. Editing an active trigger pauses it until a person approves it again. Does not activate a trigger.

event_name.description: Observed product event from the last 30 days, such as a failed action or onboarding step.

anyOf.description: Page URL rule. Matches the page path, query or hash.

url.description: Page URL rule. Matches the page path, query or hash.

anyOf.description: Trigger source. page_visit pairs with event_name "$pageview" for URL or dwell triggers.

source.description: Trigger source. page_visit pairs with event_name "$pageview" for URL or dwell triggers.

sampling_percent.description: Percent of matching users to invite (default 100).

cooldown_days.description: Days before the same user can be invited again (default 30).

max_invites_per_day.description: Daily invitation cap for this trigger (default 100).

intercept_title.description: Small label above the prompt, e.g. "AI-guided · 2-3 minutes".

intercept_body.description: Prompt text shown to the user.

delivery_method.description: intercept (default): in-app voice/text widget via the Usercall SDK. webhook: POST each matched user to webhook_url.

webhook_url.description: Public https endpoint for delivery_method webhook. Receives user ID, email, traits, event properties and a personal interview link. To remove a webhook, set delivery_method "intercept" (clears webhook_url and webhook_secret).

webhook_secret.description: Optional HMAC secret. Requests carry x-usercall-signature. Write-only: never returned. null removes it.

invite_link_params.description: Query params copied onto interview links when the study has link context enabled.

status.description: Trigger status. "paused" pauses the trigger. "active" is rejected with HTTP 409 and activation_url; a person opens that URL to activate.

tools.name: delete_research_trigger
tools.title: Delete a research trigger
tools.description: Permanently delete an in-product research trigger. Interviews already completed stay on the study, including their themes and quotes. Cannot be undone. Does not delete the interview study. A paused trigger stops new invites and keeps the trigger.
